notes: Group: Everything Else. FULL portrait SITE overlay printed sideways that RENAMES the site (sleeve over Tatooine: Cantina (Light)): both bars '•CORUSCANT: NIGHT CLUB' (red • on Light bar, white • on Dark bar). Heading '•Coruscant: Night Club (Light) (V)'; caption '•Tatooine: Cantina (Light) (V)' — title named by the bar (rev 23). Both halves print the SAME text, one line each. Two blue sabers (Light) and two red sabers (Dark) — as the printed Cantina. Icon boxes both bars, outermost first: planet, interior; no scomp. Bottom margin: VS16 sphere + black EPISODE I disc → icons ['episode1'] (a Premiere card prints no Episode I icon). CHANGES vs printed Tatooine: Cantina (Premiere, Light): renamed; texts replaced (printed Light 'Your aliens here are each power +1.'; Dark 'Your aliens here, except Tusken Raiders, are each forfeit +1.'). Slip text matches the stub. Base 490×350 only; Premiere 1995 copyright by set. Modern: VB5-L-coruscantnightclub-pre.gif (Virtual Block 5 reissue of this slip, same Cantina art); V0-L-coruscantnightclub.gif (1039×745, Virtual Set 0 remake, same art, 'Tatooine: Cantina (Light)' caption) also downloaded — better art source. Sites have no lore.
